text: {"question":"How does the proposed lunar far‑side observational strategy for cosmology relate to the assumption that the local gravitational field is quiescent in the cosmological model discussed?","reference_answer":"The lunar far‑side strategy relies on a quiet, radio‑silent environment to make precise measurements, mirroring the model’s assumption of a quiescent local gravitational field; both emphasize the importance of minimal local disturbances to probe fundamental cosmological parameters."}
